name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A modal panel at an edge of the screen: the card's #171717 fill with a hairline on its inner edge, a Funnel Display title, the body scrolling on its own and buttons at the foot. It slides in on the drawer curve; Escape closes it at once.
use_for: Details, filters or settings beside what someone is doing: a search's filters, a brand's details. Right is the default; left, top and bottom when the layout asks for it.
never: A short question or a confirmation: use Dialog or Alert Dialog
A shadow or a glow: the fill, the hairline and the scrim set it apart
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no sheet in the brand assets): the plan card's #171717 fill, Funnel Display for its title, the neutral steps for the hairline and the scrim
